### privatelink-wp-unidirectional-overlapping-ips

**Claim.** In PrivateLink only the clients in the consumer VPC can initiate a connection to the service, and it suits client and server VPCs with overlapping IP addresses because the endpoint network interfaces sit in the client VPC and cause no IP conflicts with the provider.

**Write it as.** `no IP conflicts with the service provider` · `overlapping IP addresses`

**Scope.** AWS PrivateLink design.

> "Only the clients with access in the consumer VPC can initiate a connection to the service in the service provider VPC or AWS service. This is also a good option when client and servers in the two VPCs have overlapping IP addresses because AWS PrivateLink uses ENIs within the client VPC in a manner that ensures that are no IP conflicts with the service provider."
> — [AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/aws-privatelink.html)
